question: ________ is one of the most popular folk dances of Odisha.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Dalkhai.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The dance Dalkai originates from the **Sambalpur district of Odisha.**
 
• It is usually performed to please Goddess Durga and is one of the most popular traditional folk-dance forms of Adivasi's of Sambalpur.
 
• It is commonly performed at festivals like Dashahra, Bhaijiuntia, Phagun Puni, Nuakhai, etc.
 
• The main theme of this dance form is Radha and Krishna, Ramayana, and Mahabharata.
 
• Popular **Dances of Odisha**:
 
 
• **Odissi Dance.**
 
• **Chhau Dance.**
 
• **Chaiti Ghoda.**
 
• **Danda Nata.**
 
• **Medha Nacha.**
 
• **Changu Dance.**
 
• **Karma Dance.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Giddha:**

 
 
• Gidha is a popular dance form of Punjab.
 
• It is performed during the most joyous occasions held in Punjab. It is performed only by the ladies.
 
• Gidha was derived from the** ancient dance called the ring dance**.
 
• The costume for this dance is very simple.
 
• The jewelry, the music used for the dance also plays a vital role in defining the uniqueness of the dance.
 
• There are no instruments involved in the Gidha dance apart from a **dhol.**
 
• It is not performed according to any **cut and dried rule.**
 
 
 
• **​Hojagiri:**
 
 
• Hojagiri is a folk dance mainly performed in the state of **Tripura.** It is mainly performed on the occasion of Hojagiri festivals.
 
• The dance is performed by** only women, of about 4 to 6 members** in a team.
 
• The** Riang clan of Tripuri people** performs this dance and they are very expert.
 
• The male members participate in** singing the lyrics, playing the Kham, Sumui**.
 
 
 
• **Rauf:**
 
 
• 'Rauf' is a folk dance associated with the state of **Jammu and Kashmir.**
 
• Apart from this, other folk dances of Jammu and Kashmir include **Damali, Hikat, Mandjas**, etc.
